## Shared scenes

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) collapses from sudden heart failure caused by shock after reading news of the Abbey Bank's collapse, and dies instantly. Household members and community neighbors gather to mourn him, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) try to comfort each other through their profound grief. In the following days, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confides her feelings to Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and later shares a quiet evening conversation with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss their plans for the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) while driving home from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody). Spotting a cow in Mr. Harrison's grain field, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hastily sells it to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) thinking it is her own cow, Dolly. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers Dolly is still in the pen and realizes she sold Mr. Harrison's cow by mistake, leading her to set off to apologize with a peace-offering cake.
>
> — v2 · II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure
